# Clink Official Docs Export

## Quickstart

Clink supports merchant standard integration and merchant agent integration.

## Integration

Merchant standard integration covers checkout session creation, `POST /payment`, `POST /subscription`,
`POST /billing/session`, webhook handling, and refund synchronization.

Merchant agent integration covers `POST /order/payment-session`, `GET /order/payment-session/{sessionId}`, and `WEBHOOK customer.verify`.

## Checkout Session

Use `/checkout/session` to create a checkout session. API requests send `X-API-Key` and a fresh
millisecond `X-Timestamp`. Elements uses `uiMode: "elements"` and `returnUrl` with
`{ELEMENTS_SESSION_ID}`. Checkout supports `paymentMethodSortOrder`, `localPriceOnly`,
promotion codes, `historicalPaymentInstrumentImport`, and `scheduledPhases`.

## Refund

Refunds are modeled as a lifecycle. `POST /refund` creates a refund and `GET /refund/{id}`
retrieves it. The request requires `orderId`, `refundMerchantOrderId`, and `refundAmount`;
reusing `refundMerchantOrderId` is idempotent. Webhooks include `refund.created`,
`refund.succeeded`, and `refund.failed`.

## Webhooks

Webhook implementations should verify `X-Clink-SignType: SHA256`, `X-Clink-Timestamp`, and
`X-Clink-Signature` using raw-body HMAC SHA-256 and a constant-time comparison. Subscribe to
`order.created`, `order.next_action`, `order.succeeded`, and `order.failed`; a Session may have
multiple payment attempts. Keep Session lifecycle separate from payment state, tolerate retries
and out-of-order delivery, and retain a dead-letter/outbox record after retry exhaustion.

Agent-facing docs cover Clink MCP, UCP Checkout, Wallet Service, Browser Pay, OAuth/PKCE, and
Operation recovery. The live `clink://skill/rules` resource is authoritative for current MCP
tool schemas and the closed `next_action` set.
